name: Orla Dock
description:
A dock for GNOME Shell inspired by the macOS Dock, made to fit your desktop.

• Folders open as a fan that folds back the same way it opened
• Three bar styles with a preview: macOS dock, Windows 10 taskbar and GNOME dock
• Pick the screen side by clicking a preview
• Optionally touches the screen edge while a window is maximized
